limitations: All original skill ranks and selected promotion/potential talents are used; modules are unavailable.
Valarqvin's IS4-only The One Who Reveals talent requires the original rogue_sami map tag and is excluded from this regular-stage prototype.

Necrosis injury is based on current ATK independently from Arts mitigation and the primary attack scale. Prototype injury follows accepted Arts output, including fully absorbed output; exact native cancellation/dodge/shield ordering and same-hit burst ordering are unrecovered.
Source default Front/Back bytes, native attack events and projectile speed8 are verified; native frame replay and Unity particle effects are not implemented.
